summary.name: X Lossless Decoder (XLD)
summary.one_liner: XLD is a macOS audio tool that decodes, converts, and plays lossless audio files, can split tracks using cue sheets, and can rip audio CDs.
use_cases: Convert FLAC, APE, WavPack or ALAC files to WAV or AIFF
Split a single lossless album image into tracks using a cue sheet
Rip tracks from an audio CD to FLAC, ALAC, MP3 or AAC
Batch convert audio files from the command line
Play lossless audio files on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: XLD decodes many lossless formats including FLAC, Monkey's Audio, WavPack, TTA, Apple Lossless, and Shorten (v3 only), with TAK support requiring Wine or CrossOver. It splits files into tracks using an external or embedded cue sheet during decoding, without generating intermediate files. It converts audio to WAV, AIFF, raw PCM, Ogg Vorbis, AAC, MP3, Apple Lossless, FLAC, Wave64, WavPack, and Opus, and can rip audio CDs (version 20080812 and later) to track files or a single image with cue sheet. A command-line version (xld) offers options for format, output path, track selection, pre-gap exclusion, and raw input settings.
notable: Uses libraries rather than external decoder frontends, so no intermediate files are created
Universal Binary with a command-line version included in the archive
Supports reading and writing MusicBrainz, Discogs and CDDB metadata, plus AccurateRip and log checking plugins
Plugin architecture for optional encoders such as Vorbis, LAME, and FDK AAC
caveats: TAK decoding requires Wine, CrossOver Mac, or WineBottler
Shorten decoding only supports SHN v3
Runs only on macOS (Mac OS X); the page does not mention other platforms
Some encoders are optional plugins that must be installed separately, and external plugins may need updates for newer architectures
